productPurpose: A squad analysis tool that translates Football Manager attributes into football-facing style lenses without recommending formations.

lenses.label: High Pressing Capacity
lenses.shortMeaning: How ready the squad is to press, counter-press and sustain repeated regain actions.
lenses.description: High scores suggest the squad can press high, force rushed decisions and repeat pressure actions without losing compactness. Lower scores suggest the press may look active, but arrive late, open gaps or fade over time.
coachQuestions: Can the team lock opponents high?
Can the press be repeated without losing structure?

lenses.label: High Line Control
lenses.shortMeaning: How safely the team can defend with space behind the back line.
lenses.description: High scores suggest the defensive line can hold a high position, compress the pitch, time the line together and recover when opponents attack the space behind. Lower scores suggest the team may be exposed by runs in behind, direct balls or poor offside-line timing.
coachQuestions: Can the team hold a high defensive line?
Can the back line time the offside line and recover?

lenses.label: Low block: defend the box
lenses.shortMeaning: Can the player defend deep around the penalty area when the team absorbs pressure?
lenses.description: High scores point to players who can hold position, track danger early, defend crosses and survive long spells around their own box. Lower scores suggest the player may struggle when the team has to defend deep, deal with runners and manage repeated penalty-area pressure.
coachQuestions: How safe is the team when defending the area?
Can the squad absorb pressure around its own goal?

lenses.label: Possession Control
lenses.shortMeaning: Can the squad keep the ball under pressure, circulate with purpose, control rhythm and avoid cheap turnovers?
lenses.description: High scores suggest the squad can keep the ball under pressure, circulate with purpose and control the rhythm of the game. Lower scores suggest rushed touches, poor support angles and preventable turnovers.
coachQuestions: Can the team keep the ball under pressure?
Can the squad control rhythm and avoid cheap turnovers?

lenses.label: Direct Progression
lenses.shortMeaning: Can the squad turn regains or early openings into forward attacks quickly, before the opponent reorganises?
lenses.description: High scores point to players who can turn regains or early openings into forward attacks quickly. Lower scores suggest the team may recycle safely, slow the attack down or fail to attack space before the opponent reorganises.
coachQuestions: Can the team attack forward quickly?
Can the squad turn regains into threat?

lenses.label: 1v1 Threat
lenses.shortMeaning: Can the player create imbalance by beating a defender, carrying the ball into dangerous areas and forcing the opponent to adjust, double up or lose structure?
lenses.description: High scores point to players who can beat defenders, carry the ball into dangerous areas and force the opponent to adjust or double up. Lower scores suggest the squad may rely more on combinations than individual elimination.
coachQuestions: Who can beat a defender and create separation?
Does the squad have enough individual destabilising power?

lenses.label: Final Third Creation
lenses.shortMeaning: Can the player create chances in the final third through vision, passing quality, combinations, crosses or individual creativity?
lenses.description: High scores point to players who can create chances in the final third through vision, passing quality, combinations, crosses or individual creativity. Lower scores suggest the squad may reach advanced areas but lack the final action to open opponents.
coachQuestions: Who can create chances in the final third?
Does the squad have enough final-ball quality?

lenses.label: Penalty-Area Goal Threat
lenses.shortMeaning: Can the player arrive in dangerous areas, read chances early and turn box entries into shots and goals?
lenses.description: High scores point to players who can arrive in the right areas, read chances early and turn box entries into shots and goals. Lower scores suggest the team may reach dangerous zones without enough finishing threat.
coachQuestions: Who turns box entries into goals?
Does the squad have enough penalty-area goal threat?

lenses.label: Transition Security
lenses.shortMeaning: Can the player protect the team after possession is lost, stop counters early and keep the centre secure?
lenses.description: High scores point to players who can protect the team after possession is lost, stop counters early and keep the centre secure. Lower scores suggest the team may attack well but become exposed when the ball turns over.
coachQuestions: Who protects the team after ball loss?
Can the squad stop counters before they become dangerous?

lenses.label: No. 6 Profile
lenses.shortMeaning: Who can anchor play centrally, protect the line in front and keep the team connected on the ball.
lenses.description: High scores point to players who can receive under pressure, hold central balance and make good choices from the base of midfield. Lower scores suggest the central platform may need to be shared rather than placed on one player.
coachQuestions: Do we have a real single-anchor profile?
Is central security strong enough to rely on one controller?

depthRules.reading: Single-anchor structure is possible but fragile.
Central load should be shared more than anchored.

lenses.label: Wing Play
lenses.shortMeaning: Can the player stretch the pitch wide, carry the ball at speed down the flank and deliver end product?
lenses.description: High scores point to players who can receive wide, beat a full-back, carry the ball into advanced areas and deliver a cross or cut inside to shoot. Lower scores suggest the wide areas may lack speed, directness or the ability to reach the byline consistently.
coachQuestions: Who can stretch the pitch from wide areas?
Can the squad deliver consistent wide threat?

lenses.label: Crossing Specialist
lenses.shortMeaning: Can the player deliver accurate crosses from wide or deep positions into the penalty area?
lenses.description: High scores point to players who can deliver accurate, well-timed crosses from different angles and under pressure. Lower scores suggest the squad may reach wide areas but lack the final delivery quality to create headed or volleyed chances.
coachQuestions: Who can deliver dangerous crosses consistently?
Does the squad have enough crossing quality from wide areas?

lenses.label: Playmaker
lenses.shortMeaning: Can the player control the tempo, find passes others cannot see and connect the team through the middle or half-spaces?
lenses.description: High scores point to players who can dictate the rhythm, pick the right pass under pressure and make the team play through them. Lower scores suggest the squad may lack a true conductor who can set the pace, change the point of attack and unlock defences with a single pass.
coachQuestions: Do we have a player who can dictate the game?
Can someone consistently find the pass that opens the defence?

lenses.label: Cut Inside Threat
lenses.shortMeaning: Can the player receive wide, cut onto a stronger foot and create shots or through balls from inside positions?
lenses.description: High scores point to players who can start wide, drive inside past defenders and create dangerous shooting or passing angles from half-spaces. Lower scores suggest the squad may have wide players who stay on the touchline rather than threatening the goal from inside positions.
coachQuestions: Who can cut inside and threaten the goal?
Does the squad have inverted wingers who can shoot or create from half-spaces?

notes: Leadership and Determination matter in squad building, but they should not drive the style-lens score itself.
Set-piece attributes can appear as accents, not as core style drivers.
Each lens should show all outfield players ranked on the relevant attributes for that single lens.
